evidence.title: PersianLabs/ui — Copy-paste components for Persian interfaces

name: PersianLabs/ui
summary: Open-source, RTL-first component library for Persian interfaces, installed by copy-paste through a shadcn registry.
description: A copy-paste component library built RTL-first for Persian interfaces on top of Base UI and shadcn/ui — there is no package to install, components land in your codebase through the shadcn registry CLI. Ships Persian typography, offline fonts and Farsi digits, with docs for theming, RTL and Persian conventions, and a markdown twin plus an llms.txt index for every page.
contains: components for input, button, modal, select, slider, switch, sidebar, checkbox, date picker and more
Persian typography, offline fonts and Farsi digits baked in
RTL, theming and Persian conventions docs
llms.txt index and markdown twin (append .md) for every doc page
premium Persian admin dashboard template on the site (Velin, Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4)
